scripts.build: npx wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv ./env.d.ts && next build
scripts.preview: npm run build:prod && npx opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env prod
scripts.deploy: npm run build:prod && npx opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env prod
scripts.upload: npm run build:prod && npx opennextjs-cloudflare upload --env prod
scripts.preview:dev: npm run build:dev && npx opennextjs-cloudflare preview --env dev
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npx opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env dev
scripts.upload:dev: npm run build:dev && npx opennextjs-cloudflare upload --env dev
